title_original: More departures at National Gallery Singapore
excerpt_original: Chief curator Patrick Flores and assistant chief executive Chris Lee will leave the institution in December

blocks.caption: National Gallery Singapore atrium. Courtesy National Gallery Singapore

blocks.text: Patrick Flores and Chris Lee, respectively the chief curator and assistant chief executive of the National Gallery Singapore, will leave the institution in December, The Strait Times reports.

Their departure will coincide with that of chief executive Eugene Tan who announced in September that he would be stepping down. Chng Hak-Peng will be taking over Tan’s role. Details have yet to be announced regarding the positions of chief curator and assistant chief executive.
